title: 自动核酸提取仪的安全使用（国内版）

points.K1: 提取病毒核酸，规程先行
points.K2: 卡盒式提取，在机器里完成
points.K3: 卡盒：每排三孔，一次两块
points.K13: 演示归演示，使用在实验室
points.K14: 选提取、选程序、选试剂盒
points.K16: 开始运行：裂解、捕获、洗脱
points.K17: 到相应实验室实际操作
points.K18: 启动前，确认耗材放到位
points.S3: 运行中不开门，出错先暂停

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台空白外壳的自动核酸提取仪旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to an automated nucleic acid extraction instrument with a plain blank casing and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天认识一位新帮手：自动核酸提取仪。
overlay: 自动核酸提取仪的安全使用

shots.scene: 阿杰面前一大排样本管，手里拿着移液器发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits in front of a long rack of sample tubes holding a pipette, looking overwhelmed.
shots.narration: 阿杰要提几十份样本的核酸。

shots.scene: 小研推来提取仪，阿杰眼睛一亮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wheels in the extraction instrument on a cart and the young male student brightens up.
shots.narration: 小研说：用自动提取仪，又快又稳。

shots.scene: 阿杰想直接在推车上开始，老周摆手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches to start right there on the cart, and the older man shakes his head.
shots.narration: 老周提醒：机器再好，规矩也不能少。

shots.section_title: 提取病毒核酸，规程先行
shots.scene: 病毒图标、核酸双螺旋图标和实验室门
shots.prompt_en: A virus icon, a nucleic acid helix icon and a laboratory door with a biosafety level pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 提取病毒核酸，已是常规工作。
overlay: 提取病毒核酸，规程先行

shots.section_title: 提取病毒核酸，规程先行
shots.scene: 生物安全和生物安保两本空白规程
shots.prompt_en: Two blank procedure binders with a shield icon and a padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 但必须遵守生物安全和安保规程。

shots.section_title: 提取病毒核酸，规程先行
shots.scene: 实验室门上的级别图标和一个审批印章
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory door with a biosafety level pictogram and an approval stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 在相应级别的实验室里做。

shots.section_title: 卡盒式提取，在机器里完成
shots.scene: 提取仪前门打开，里面是卡盒托架
shots.prompt_en: The extraction instrument with its front door open, showing a cartridge tray inside. No people.
shots.narration: 这台仪器用预先封装的卡盒。
overlay: 卡盒式提取，在机器里完成

shots.section_title: 卡盒式提取，在机器里完成
shots.scene: 仪器剖面：试剂和样本都在机器内部流转
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of the instrument showing liquids moving between wells entirely inside the closed housing. No people.
shots.narration: 提取全过程，都在机器里完成。

shots.section_title: 卡盒：每排三孔，一次两块
shots.scene: 一块卡盒俯视图，每排三个孔，共八排
shots.prompt_en: Top view of an extraction cartridge with three wells in each row and eight rows. No people.
shots.narration: 卡盒每排三个孔，一共八排。
overlay: 卡盒：每排三孔，一次两块

shots.section_title: 卡盒：每排三孔，一次两块
shots.scene: 两块卡盒并排放进托架
shots.prompt_en: Two cartridges sitting side by side in the instrument tray. No people.
shots.narration: 一次可以放两块。

shots.scene: 磁力板图标，小磁珠被吸到孔底
shots.prompt_en: A magnetic plate icon under a well; tiny beads gather at the bottom of the well. No people.
shots.narration: 还配了一块磁力板。

shots.scene: 移液器从孔上方吸出清液，磁珠留在底部
shots.prompt_en: A pipette tip draws clear liquid from the top of a well while the beads stay at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 磁珠吸到底，上面的样本好吸出。

shots.scene: 一排透明的专用条和一块空白校准板
shots.prompt_en: A row of clear plastic strips next to a plain grey calibration plate. No people.
shots.narration: 配套耗材还有专用条和校准板。

shots.scene: 老李拿着空白记录本站在仪器旁，阿杰的手被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a blank service log beside the instrument; a hand reaching for the calibration plate is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 校准由厂方或专业人员做，别自己动。

shots.scene: 提取仪放在生物安全柜里的台面后部
shots.prompt_en: The extraction instrument sits toward the back of the work surface inside a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 提取要在生物安全柜里进行。

shots.scene: 开管时飞出的小飞沫被柜内气流向下带走
shots.prompt_en: Tiny droplets from an opened tube are carried downward by the cabinet airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 开管、加样产生的气溶胶，留在柜里。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套按下电源，触摸屏亮起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves presses the power button and the blank touch screen lights up.
shots.narration: 开机后，屏幕上有两个主功能。

shots.scene: 屏幕上两个大按钮图标：核酸螺旋和灯泡
shots.prompt_en: A touch screen with two large buttons: a helix icon and a lamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一个是提取，一个是消毒。

shots.scene: 屏幕上的时间选择滑块图标
shots.prompt_en: A touch screen showing a timer slider icon. No people.
shots.narration: 点消毒，选好时间就能启动。

shots.scene: 仪器腔内亮起青绿色的紫外灯
shots.prompt_en: Inside the closed instrument chamber a teal ultraviolet lamp glows. No people.
shots.narration: 腔内的紫外灯会亮起来。

shots.scene: 紫外灯亮时门关着，眼睛图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The instrument door stays closed while the lamp glows; an eye icon looking in is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外伤眼伤皮肤，亮灯时别开门看。

shots.scene: 打开前门，一排金属磁棒垂下来
shots.prompt_en: With the front door open, a row of metal magnetic rods hangs down inside the instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 打开前门，上面是一排磁棒，

shots.scene: 下方的金属加热块，有一排排孔
shots.prompt_en: A metal heating block with rows of holes below the rods. No people.
shots.narration: 下面是加热块。

shots.scene: 小研把透明专用条插入卡槽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slides a clear plastic strip into its slot under the magnetic rods.
shots.narration: 先把专用条装进各自的卡槽。

shots.scene: 专用条卡紧的特写，旁边一个锁图标
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the strip clicking into place with a small padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每一条都要锁紧，不能松。

shots.scene: 样本板俯视图：三排样本孔，两排试剂孔，一排收集孔
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a sample plate with color-coded rows: sample wells, two reagent rows and one collection row. No people.
shots.narration: 样本板上有样本孔，

shots.scene: 收集孔一排被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The final collection row on the plate is highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 也有试剂孔，最后一排收集提取物。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里向孔中加样
shots.prompt_en: Inside a biological safety cabinet, the female graduate student pipettes samples into the plate wells.
shots.narration: 在柜里把样本加进孔中。

shots.scene: 板上的封膜被撕开的示意
shots.prompt_en: A sealing film being peeled off the top of a pre-filled plate. No people.
shots.narration: 试剂孔预先封好，用时再撕膜，

shots.scene: 预封装的板在运输箱里不洒的图标
shots.prompt_en: A sealed plate tilted in a box with no liquid spilling, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 运输时不怕洒。

shots.scene: 小研把整块板推入仪器托架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slides the whole plate into the instrument tray.
shots.narration: 加好样，把整块板推进仪器。

shots.section_title: 演示归演示，使用在实验室
shots.scene: 推车上的仪器被打叉，箭头指向实验室门
shots.prompt_en: An instrument on an open cart in a corridor is crossed out with a red X; an arrow points to a laboratory door. No people.
shots.narration: 原片是在实验室外的演示。
overlay: 演示归演示，使用在实验室

shots.section_title: 演示归演示，使用在实验室
shots.scene: 仪器在实验室生物安全柜里运行
shots.prompt_en: The instrument running inside a biological safety cabinet in a laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 真正使用，一定要在实验室里。

shots.section_title: 选提取、选程序、选试剂盒
shots.scene: 屏幕上提取按钮被点亮
shots.prompt_en: A finger icon taps the helix button on a blank touch screen. No people.
shots.narration: 先点“提取”，
overlay: 选提取、选程序、选试剂盒

shots.section_title: 选提取、选程序、选试剂盒
shots.scene: 屏幕上一组六边形按钮，其中一个出现绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A touch screen with a group of blank hexagon buttons; one shows a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 再选程序，看到绿色对勾才算选上。

shots.section_title: 选提取、选程序、选试剂盒
shots.scene: 屏幕上试剂盒图标和样本类型图标对应
shots.prompt_en: A touch screen matching a reagent kit icon with a virus icon. No people.
shots.narration: 然后选和样本对应的试剂盒。

shots.section_title: 选提取、选程序、选试剂盒
shots.scene: 选错程序的屏幕被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A touch screen with a mismatched kit icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 程序选错，提取就白做了。

shots.scene: 屏幕上两组加热块开关，一组开，一组灰色
shots.prompt_en: A touch screen with two heater groups: one switched on, the other greyed out. No people.
shots.narration: 装了几块卡盒，就打开几块加热块。

shots.scene: 灰色图标旁一个说明箭头
shots.prompt_en: A greyed-out heater icon with a pointer arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 灰色表示关闭。

shots.section_title: 开始运行：裂解、捕获、洗脱
shots.scene: 小研点“设置”，再点“开始”
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student taps the set button and then the start button on the blank touch screen.
shots.narration: 设置好，点开始。
overlay: 开始运行：裂解、捕获、洗脱

shots.section_title: 开始运行：裂解、捕获、洗脱
shots.scene: 三步流程图：裂解、磁珠捕获、洗脱
shots.prompt_en: A three-step flow diagram: cells breaking open, magnetic beads capturing strands, and clean liquid collected. No people.
shots.narration: 机器自动裂解、磁珠捕获、洗脱。

shots.section_title: 开始运行：裂解、捕获、洗脱
shots.scene: 屏幕上的计时器图标在走
shots.prompt_en: A countdown timer icon running on the touch screen. No people.
shots.narration: 十几分钟，一批就完成了。

shots.section_title: 到相应实验室实际操作
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰走进实验室，准备实际操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student walk into the laboratory ready for hands-on practice.
shots.narration: 学会了步骤，再到实验室实际操作。
overlay: 到相应实验室实际操作

shots.section_title: 启动前，确认耗材放到位
shots.scene: 仪器上的黄色警示标签，只有感叹号图标
shots.prompt_en: A yellow caution label with only an exclamation mark icon on the instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器上贴着一张警示标签。
overlay: 启动前，确认耗材放到位

shots.section_title: 启动前，确认耗材放到位
shots.scene: 小研弯腰检查卡盒是否卡平
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student bends down to check that the cartridges sit flat in the tray.
shots.narration: 启动前，再确认卡盒放平放到位。

shots.section_title: 启动前，确认耗材放到位
shots.scene: 卡盒歪斜、磁棒撞上的示意被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A tilted cartridge being hit by descending rods, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 放歪了，会撞坏仪器、洒出样本。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜里放着大仪器，气流箭头被挡乱
shots.prompt_en: A bulky instrument inside a biological safety cabinet with the airflow arrows disrupted around it. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器放进柜里，会影响气流。

shots.scene: 前格栅被仪器挡住，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An instrument blocking the front air grille of the cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别挡住前面和后面的格栅。

shots.scene: 仪器放在台面后部，散热风扇图标
shots.prompt_en: The instrument placed toward the back of the cabinet with a small cooling fan icon. No people.
shots.narration: 散热风扇也会吹乱气流。

shots.scene: 老李用空白检测仪测柜内气流，王老师在旁记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the cabinet airflow with a blank meter while the safety administrator takes notes.
shots.narration: 先做风险评估，必要时测气流。

shots.scene: 裂解液瓶子，瓶上有化学品象形图
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of lysis buffer with a chemical hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 裂解液和洗液，含有化学试剂。

shots.scene: 小研翻看空白的安全说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet booklet.
shots.narration: 用前查化学品安全说明书。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜和手套撕膜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in safety goggles and gloves peels the film from a plate.
shots.narration: 撕膜、加样，戴好护目镜和手套。

shots.scene: 裂解废液和含氯消毒剂瓶子混在一起，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lysis waste container and a chlorine bleach bottle being poured together, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 裂解废液不能和含氯消毒剂混。

shots.scene: 两个分开的废液桶，各贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Two separate waste containers with blank labels, one with a biohazard warning sign and one with a chemical pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 废液分开收集，按规定处置。

shots.section_title: 运行中不开门，出错先暂停
shots.scene: 运行中的仪器，门关着，一只手去拉门被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The instrument running with its door closed; a hand pulling the door open is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 运行中不要开门。
overlay: 运行中不开门，出错先暂停

shots.section_title: 运行中不开门，出错先暂停
shots.scene: 屏幕弹出报警图标，小研按下暂停
shots.prompt_en: A warning icon pops up on the screen and the female graduate student presses the pause button.
shots.narration: 报错了，先按暂停，等它停稳。

shots.section_title: 运行中不开门，出错先暂停
shots.scene: 手伸进运动的磁棒中间，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand reaching in between moving magnetic rods, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要把手伸进运动部件。

shots.section_title: 运行中不开门，出错先暂停
shots.scene: 小研给老李打电话，旁边记录本
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student phones the facility engineer, with a blank logbook beside her.
shots.narration: 按规程处理，报告负责人和老李。

shots.scene: 小研把用过的卡盒和条放进生物危害废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student drops used cartridges and strips into a biohazard waste bag inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 用完的卡盒和条，按感染性废物处理。

shots.scene: 拔下电源插头的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power plug being pulled from a socket. No people.
shots.narration: 清洁前，先关机断电。

shots.scene: 小研用浸了消毒剂的纸巾擦托架和腔体
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the tray and inner chamber with a disinfectant-soaked paper towel.
shots.narration: 用适合的消毒剂擦拭托架和腔体。

shots.scene: 空白维护记录本和日历，紫外灯图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank maintenance log with a calendar and an ultraviolet lamp icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外灯也会老化，要定期检查记录。

shots.scene: 老李打开仪器后盖维修，阿杰只在旁看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer services the instrument with its back panel open while the young male student watches from a distance.
shots.narration: 维修校准，交给专业人员。

shots.scene: 穿便装、只戴手套的人形图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a person in everyday clothes wearing only gloves, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只戴手套、穿便服上机，不行。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿上实验服，戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a lab gown, safety goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 实验服、护目镜、手套，一样不少。

shots.scene: 阿杰把手套口拉过袖口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls his glove cuffs over the sleeves of his lab gown.
shots.narration: 手套要盖住袖口。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现装条、样本板、屏幕三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a strip, a sample plate and a touch screen.
shots.narration: 装条锁紧，柜内加样，选对程序。

shots.scene: 警示标签、关门运行、暂停按钮图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a caution label, a closed instrument door and a pause button. No people.
shots.narration: 放到位再启动，运行中不开门。

shots.scene: 化学品象形图、分开的废液桶、消毒擦拭图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a chemical pictogram, two separate waste containers and wiping with disinfectant. No people.
shots.narration: 防化学危害，废液分开，用完去污。

shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍提取仪，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the extraction instrument and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 机器帮你干活，安全还得靠你，再见！
